objects.name: Google Chrome security advisory (AV26-634)
objects.description: Serial number: AV26-634 Date: June 26, 2026 On June 25, 2026, Google published a security advisory to address vulnerabilities in the following product: Stable Channel Chrome for Desktop – versions prior to0.7827.200/201 (Windows/Mac), and 149.0.7827.200 (Linux) The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web link and apply the necessary updates, when available.
